select
  e.id as enrollment_id,
  cl.id as class_id,
  c.id as course_id,
  cl.name as className,
  d."name" as departmentName,
  cl.amount,
  c.code as courseCode,
  c.name as courseName,
  c.duration
from "Enrollment" e
join "Class" cl on e.class_id = cl.id
join "Course" c on e.course_id = c.id
join "Department" d on d.id = cl.department_id
order by d.id, cl.id, c.id;

INSERT INTO "ExamPlan"
(runkey, exam_unit_id, enrollment_id, class_id, course_id,
 classname, departmentname, coursecode, coursename, duration,
 violations)
VALUES
(
  '{{ $json.runkey }}',

  {{ $node["Prepare ExamUnit Rows"].json.enrollment_id }},

  {{ $node["Prepare ExamUnit Rows"].json.course_id }},
  '{{ $node["Prepare ExamUnit Rows"].json.meta.className }}',
  '{{ $node["Prepare ExamUnit Rows"].json.meta.departmentName }}',

  '{{ $node["Prepare ExamUnit Rows"].json.meta.courseName }}',
  {{ $node["Prepare ExamUnit Rows"].json.duration }},
  '[]'::jsonb
)

SELECT
  p.id                 AS exam_plan_id,
  p.runkey,
  p.classname          AS "className",
  p.departmentname     AS "departmentName",
  p.coursecode         AS "courseCode",
  p.coursename         AS "courseName",
  p.duration,
  (u.meta->>'groupNum')::int AS "groupNum"
FROM "ExamPlan" p
JOIN "ExamUnit" u ON u.id = p.exam_unit_id
WHERE p.runkey = '{{ $("Insert Exam Run").first().json.runkey }}'
ORDER BY p.id;

UPDATE "ExamPlan"
SET
  /* แปลง String เป็น timestamp ธรรมดาก่อน แล้วระบุว่าเวลาเป็น Bangkok */
  timestart = '{{ $json.timeStart }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok',
  timeend   = '{{ $json.timeEnd }}'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok',
  violations = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.violations) }}'::jsonb
WHERE id = {{ $json.exam_plan_id }};

select
  ep.id as exam_plan_id,
  ep.classname,
  ep.departmentname,
  (ep.timestart AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok') as timestart_th,
  (ep.timeend   AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok') as timeend_th,
  ep.coursecode,
  ep.coursename,
  ep.roomnumber as "roomNumber"
from "ExamPlan" ep
where ep.runkey = (select er.runkey from "ExamRun" er order by er.id desc limit 1)
order by ep.departmentname, ep.class_id, ep.timestart;

WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT runkey FROM "ExamRun" ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  ep.id AS exam_plan_id,   -- ⭐ สำคัญ
  ep.runkey,
  ep.class_id,
  ep.classname,
  ep.departmentname,
  ep.timestart,
  ep.timeend
FROM "ExamPlan" ep
JOIN latest_run lr ON ep.runkey = lr.runkey
WHERE ep.timestart IS NOT NULL
  AND ep.timeend IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ep.timestart, ep.timeend, ep.departmentname, ep.class_id;

WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT runkey FROM "ExamRun" ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS violation_count
FROM (
  SELECT ep.course_id
  FROM "ExamPlan" ep
  JOIN latest_run lr ON ep.runkey = lr.runkey
  WHERE ep.timestart IS NOT NULL AND ep.timeend IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ep.course_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT (ep.timestart, ep.timeend)) > 1
) v;

WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT runkey FROM "ExamRun" ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
),
course_slots AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cg."groupNum" AS groupnum,
    ep.timestart,
    ep.timeend
  FROM "ExamPlan" ep
  JOIN latest_run lr ON ep.runkey = lr.runkey
  JOIN "CourseGroup" cg ON cg.course_id = ep.course_id
  WHERE ep.timestart IS NOT NULL AND ep.timeend IS NOT NULL
    AND cg."groupNum" <> 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS violation_count
FROM (
  SELECT groupnum
  FROM course_slots
  GROUP BY groupnum
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT (timestart, timeend)) > 1
) v;

WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT runkey FROM "ExamRun" ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
),
x AS (
  SELECT
    ep.id AS exam_plan_id,
    ep.roomnumber,
    ep.timestart,
    ep.timeend
  FROM "ExamPlan" ep
  JOIN latest_run lr ON ep.runkey = lr.runkey
  WHERE ep.roomnumber IS NOT NULL
    AND ep.timestart IS NOT NULL
    AND ep.timeend IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS violation_count
FROM (
  SELECT 1
  FROM x a
  JOIN x b
    ON a.roomnumber = b.roomnumber
   AND a.exam_plan_id < b.exam_plan_id
   AND a.timestart < b.timeend
   AND b.timestart < a.timeend
) v;

WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT runkey
  FROM "ExamRun"
  ORDER BY id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    ep.class_id,
    ep.timestart,
    ep.timeend,
    DATE(ep.timestart) AS exam_date,
    LAG(ep.timeend) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ep.class_id, DATE(ep.timestart)
      ORDER BY ep.timestart
    ) AS prev_end
  FROM "ExamPlan" ep
  JOIN latest_run lr ON ep.runkey = lr.runkey
  WHERE ep.timestart IS NOT NULL
    AND ep.timeend IS NOT NULL
),
groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN prev_end IS NULL THEN 1
        -- มีช่องว่าง = ตัดกลุ่ม
        WHEN timestart > prev_end THEN 1
        -- ข้ามช่วงพักเที่ยง = ตัดกลุ่ม
        WHEN prev_end::time <= '12:30'
         AND timestart::time >= '13:30' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY class_id, exam_date
      ORDER BY timestart
    ) AS grp
  FROM ordered
),
durations AS (
  SELECT
    class_id,
    exam_date,
    grp,
    SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timeend - timestart)) / 60) AS total_minutes
  FROM groups
  GROUP BY class_id, exam_date, grp
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS violation_count
FROM durations
WHERE total_minutes > 240;

WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT runkey
  FROM "ExamRun"
  ORDER BY id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS violation_count
FROM "ExamPlan" ep
JOIN latest_run lr ON ep.runkey = lr.runkey
WHERE ep.roomnumber IS NULL
   OR NULLIF(BTRIM(ep.roomnumber), '') IS NULL
   OR BTRIM(ep.roomnumber) IN ('0', 'ยังไม่จัดห้อง');
